item.title: github: GitHub Advanced Security trials for GitHub Team
item.description:
GitHub Team customers can now start self-serve trials of GitHub Advanced Security from an organization’s Overview page and Billing settings. The trial lets teams evaluate GitHub Code Security and GitHub Secret Protection.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot model access update for GitHub Team plans
item.description:
GitHub updated how Copilot model access is determined for users with seats in more than one organization. The change is intended to keep billing and governance aligned.

  • Source: GitHub
